reasoning: FairTix operates a lottery-based ticket marketplace but has critical gaps in their automation infrastructure. With only 3 processes automated and 36.1% failure rate on revenue-critical lottery notifications, they're losing money daily. The workflows reveal they handle verification issues (Polish +48 numbers failing), payment problems (double charges, missing tickets), and support inquiries about lottery mechanics - but none of these core business functions are automated. They're using Google Sheets as a database and have no retry logic on failed notifications. The 'dlschoolautomations@gmail.com' suggests this might be training material, but the business model is clear: fair ticket distribution through verified-human lottery system with 20% resale caps.

recommendations.reasoning: 36.1% of lottery winner notifications fail with no retry mechanism, directly losing revenue from eager buyers with 24-hour purchase windows
recommendations.name: Fix Critical Lottery Notification Failures
recommendations.businessCase: Recover 36% of potentially lost ticket sales by ensuring winners receive notifications
evidenceChain: Workflow '2 - FairTix - LotteryWin' has 36.1% error rate (13 of 36 executions failed)
No retry configuration on 'Send a message' Gmail node despite revenue impact
24-hour purchase window means failed notifications = lost sales
recommendations.implementationNotes: On 'Send a message' Gmail node in workflows 2, 2b, and 5: Add retryOnFail: true, maxTries: 3, waitBetweenTries: 60000 (exponential backoff). Add email delivery verification by checking Gmail API response for bounce indicators. Create fallback SMS notification path for critical lottery wins.

evidenceChain: Email templates mention 'Fair Queue selected you' and 'random selection'

recommendations.implementationNotes: Build workflow triggered by queue close time: 1) Query verified users who entered queue, 2) Use cryptographic randomness for selection, 3) Write winners to sheet, 4) Trigger existing notification workflow, 5) Send consolation emails to non-winners with next queue dates

1440 API calls/day per workflow for simple row monitoring

recommendations.implementationNotes: Use Google Sheets API webhook notifications or Apps Script to POST to n8n webhook endpoints on row changes. Replace polling triggers in workflows 2, 2b, 3, 4, and 5. This eliminates 7,200+ unnecessary API calls daily.

recommendations.implementationNotes: Connect payment provider (likely Stripe based on order format) via webhooks: payment.succeeded, payment.failed, charge.dispute.created. Create reconciliation workflow to match payments to orders and flag anomalies.
